articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
articles.snippet: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

articles.title: 'Privacy Horror’: Researcher Uncovers Extent of Samsung Smart TV User Tracking
articles.snippet: AI-powered reverse engineering could make it "easier and faster" for researchers to uncover and explain how devices collect and share data.
